The demand named by the recovery scope is not blocked, so no exception recovery session may be opened against it.
The eventId carried by the recovery action is not the event the exception recovery session was opened for.
The demandId carried by the recovery action is not the demand the exception recovery session was opened for.
The operator submitting the recovery action is not the administrator who opened the exception recovery session.
The exception recovery session has already selected a different recovery action.
The exception recovery session is scoped to a demand, but no station operation exists for that demand.
RESUME_AFTER_REPAIR requires the vehicle to hold a proven recovery checkpoint for the unsettled slot operation attempt.
The exception recovery session is open and stays blocked until the operator selects a recovery action.
A recovery action has been selected and the exception recovery session stays blocked until its result arrives.
The SUBLOT entered by the operator does not belong to any demand in the current dispatch scope, so the control server rejects the entry (FR-001 AC-4).
Revalidation after SUBLOT entry found no usable SUBLOT_BOX_COUNT: the lookup failed, returned nothing or returned a non-positive count (BR-013 section 2).
Revalidation after SUBLOT entry could not resolve basket capacity: PACKAGE is missing, or the approved capacity mapping has no match or conflicting matches (BR-013 section 2).

The operator did not complete the slot operation before the station departure deadline; the slot door is closed and the unlock output reset, so the slot is settled as a determinate failure rather than an unknown outcome (ADR-cross-0058 decision 5). The WIRE_TO_GATE_MVP line introduced a code of the same name and meaning in protocol-v0.3.0.
